interfaces: RecoveryAPI restore outcome and checkpoint endpoints
worker prepare and supervisor native command
metrics: restore_outcomes_by_type counts authenticated verified worker outcomes
remaining_limitations: Live capture and restore on Anton is unproven: the isolated proof controller was removed and the primary controller must be healthy first.
A spawn superseded as a legacy specification is replaced fresh without a master choice, because it never applied and holds no conversation to continue.
Duplicate restore requests are idempotent per execution and choice; there is no separate request identity.
Supported harness versions are claude 2.1 and codex 0.162; any other version refuses native resume.
rollback_rehearsal: C retained checkpoint and awaiting decision state while automation was paused
